mission: Intuitive Machines IM-1 / Odysseus / NASA CLPS TO2-IM
payload_scope: Six NASA instruments plus commercial payloads; company reported approximately 100 kg total payload, not certified capacity
destination: Malapert A, lunar South Pole region; distinct from IM-5's targeted Mons Malapert

observed_outcomes.launch: Falcon 9 launch and Nova-C separation into flight reported
observed_outcomes.transfer: Lunar orbit insertion reported after Earth-to-Moon transit
observed_outcomes.lunar_delivery: Soft landing and six NASA instruments delivered near Malapert A
observed_outcomes.site_operations: Surface data returned, with operations limited by lander leaning/orientation; ceased after seven reported days

limits: Nova-C on IM-1 is not the planned larger Nova-D on IM-5
Malapert A landing does not qualify Mons Malapert coordinates or local terrain
Reported approximately 100 kg carried is not spare capacity or an IM-5 payload allowance
Surface data return does not establish unconstrained deployment, power, data or 14-day operations for Roo-ver
IM-1 launch and transfer dates do not provide an IM-5 window, trajectory, delta-v or performance margin

sources.supports: 01:05 EST Falcon 9 launch of IM-1 Nova-C with NASA payloads
Approximately 01:53 EST separation of Nova-C from Falcon 9 second stage
Successful lunar orbit insertion on February 21; no burn event clock time admitted
17:24 CST soft landing near Malapert A and six NASA science/technology payloads
Six instruments collected data; ceased operations seven days after landing; lander orientation constrained communications and some objectives
Company reports payload data transmission, 144-hour operation objective exceeded and standby February 29
Company reports approximately 100 kg of payloads carried on IM-1 Nova-C; not a capacity specification
